about: Labelled synthetic sentences for the Machine-checked signal (modules/verification). Each item: the text, the rung it should get (none, claimed, statement-checked, outside-checked), whether it reports a fidelity gap, and its split. scripts/verification-ratchet.js tunes modules/verification/rules.json on 'train' only; 'heldout' is never used for choosing, only for accepting. Written before any tuning. Add an item whenever a mis-judgement turns up; never edit an item to make a score look better. All test data: no real papers, people or quotes.
